tools.name: swt_detection
tools.description: Detects scenes containing text in video, including slates, chyrons, and credits. Outputs TimeFrame annotations marking where text appears.

video_path.description: Path to the input video file

use_classifier.description: Whether to use the CNN classifier for text detection

use_stitcher.description: Whether to stitch TimePoints into TimeFrames

min_frame_score.description: Minimum confidence score for frame classification

label_map.description: Preset for label mapping (slate, chyron, credits, etc.)

tools.output_description: TimeFrame annotations with labels: slate, chyron, credits, lower-third, etc.

tools.name: doctr_ocr
tools.description: Performs OCR on images or video frames using docTR. Detects text regions and recognizes text content, outputting hierarchical structure (pages > blocks > lines > words).

input_path.description: Path to image file or video with TimeFrame annotations

timeframes.description: TimeFrame annotations specifying which frames to process

tools.output_description: Recognized text with spatial coordinates and confidence scores

tools.name: smolvlm2_captioner
tools.description: Uses SmolVLM2-2.2B vision-language model to generate captions and descriptions for video frames. Can answer questions about visual content.

input_path.description: Path to video file or image

timeframes.description: TimeFrame annotations specifying which frames to caption

tools.output_description: Natural language descriptions of visual content

tools.name: whisper_transcription
tools.description: Transcribes speech in audio/video using OpenAI Whisper. Outputs time-aligned text with word-level timestamps.

input_path.description: Path to audio or video file

tools.name: spacy_ner
tools.description: Performs Named Entity Recognition on text using spaCy. Identifies people, organizations, locations, dates, and other entities.

text_input.description: Text to analyze, or reference to TextDocument

tools.output_description: Named entities with types: PERSON, ORG, GPE, DATE, etc.

tools.name: scene_detection
tools.description: Detects scene boundaries in video using PySceneDetect. Identifies cuts, fades, and transitions.

tools.name: forced_alignment
tools.description: Aligns transcript text to audio using forced alignment. Produces word-level and phoneme-level time alignments.

tools.name: chyron_parser
tools.description: Parses and structures chyron text (lower-thirds, name titles). Extracts person names, titles, affiliations from on-screen text.

context.description: Additional context about the video content

tools.output_description: Structured data: person name, title, organization

tools.name: slate_parser
tools.description: Parses production slate text to extract structured metadata: show title, episode, air date, production company, etc.
tools.output_description: Structured metadata extracted from production slate

tools.name: credits_parser
tools.description: Parses end credits to extract cast and crew information with roles.
tools.output_description: Person names with their roles (actor, director, producer, etc.)

tool_categories.text_detection: Tools that detect and locate text in video/images
tool_categories.ocr: Tools that recognize and extract text content
tool_categories.captioning: Tools that generate natural language descriptions
tool_categories.speech: Tools for speech transcription and alignment
tool_categories.text_understanding: Tools that parse and structure extracted text

common_pipelines.name: full_transcription
common_pipelines.description: Complete speech transcription with speaker identification

common_pipelines.name: video_indexing
common_pipelines.description: Create searchable index of video content
